SELECT a.id, a.advertiser_id, a.title, a.creative_url, a.category_code, a.bid, a.daily_budget, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM ad a
WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.category_code = #{categoryCode}
AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ad_target t WHERE t.ad_id = a.id AND t.dim_type = 1 )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ad_target t WHERE t.ad_id = a.id AND t.dim_type = 1 AND t.dim_value = #{region} ) )
ORDER BY a.bid DESC, a.id ASC
